_doc: Raga suggestions are traditional wellness associations from Indian classical listening practice. Evidence is anecdotal; treat them as calming/focus suggestions, not therapy. Loaded at request time.

vata.goal: Calm, ground and settle a busy mind
vata.note: Choose slow, quiet renditions; keep volume low and avoid fast, jittery passages.

pitta.note: Avoid dramatic or fiery performances; favour meditative, alaap-based renditions.

kapha.note: Slightly brighter rhythms are fine earlier in the evening; keep pre-bed listening soft.

Summer.note: Traditionally associated with cooling, soothing moods.

Winter.note: Warm, serene ragas for long evenings.

Spring.note: Classical spring ragas with a light, fresh mood.

work_focus.suggestion: Instrumental only (sitar, santoor or bansuri) at low volume during deep-work sessions — search for an Indian classical instrumental study playlist.
